The page computed `featured = visibleArticles[0]` then `rest = visibleArticles.slice(1).filter(...)`, while also hiding the featured section whenever a filter was active — so the featured article was unreachable under its own category. With two AI articles in the dataset, ?category=AI showed only the second and silently dropped 'AI trong Marketing 2024...'. Fixed: the featured/slice(1) split now applies only to the unfiltered 'all' view; under any category filter the FULL visible set is filtered (`active === "all" ? visibleArticles.slice(1) : visibleArticles.filter((a) => a.category === active)`). Hidden fixtures remain excluded because the source is already getVisibleArticles().

The round-4 PR comment (5318272192) was initially posted with only a local Windows scratchpad path as its body: `gh pr comment` was failing with GitHub GraphQL 503s, and the REST fallback used `gh api -f body=@<file>`, where `-f` sends the value as a literal string rather than reading the file (`-F` is the field form that reads from a file). ChatGPT repaired the comment content manually. Corrected practice going forward: read back the posted comment body via the API and confirm it matches the intended report before treating the handback as delivered.

fixLogRound5.fix: One consistent pass, exactly as instructed. (1) Added required `demoOnly: boolean` to the Article type and set `demoOnly: true` on all 8 article fixtures (7 visible + 1 hidden). (2) Made `demoOnly` required and pinned to literal `true` on ArticlePreview and set it on all 3 preview fixtures — resolving the round-4 scope question consistently across both datasets rather than tagging only previews. (3) Surfaced the state machine-readably as `data-demo-only="true"` on ArticleCard and ArticlePreviewCard; NO visual badge added (the approved master's article cards have none). (4) Article JSON-LD is now emitted only when `!article.demoOnly` — the `articleJsonLd` helper is retained unchanged for future verified editorial content, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD still renders on every route since it describes navigation, not article facts. (5) Article detail routes are noindex when `article.demoOnly || article.hidden`, and a new `getIndexableArticles()` helper (not hidden AND not demoOnly) now feeds sitemap.ts. `getVisibleArticles()` deliberately still does NOT filter demoOnly — demo articles remain fully visible in the UI for visual parity; only structured data and indexing are gated. Static generation is untouched: next build still emits 36/36 pages including all 8 article paths.
fixLogRound5.currentEffect: getIndexableArticles() returns an empty list today by design, so sitemap.xml contains no article detail URLs at all — every fixture body is currently an unverified reconstruction. Flagged for a round-6 decision rather than unilaterally widened: if 'indexed claims' is meant to cover demo PROJECT detail routes too, the same getIndexable* treatment should be applied to projects in one deliberate pass.
